Tiger Australia Affiliate Program

About Tiger Australia

Tiger Australia is a trusted Australian brand specialising in premium cargo control and load restraint solutions. Our product range includes retractable ratchet straps, tie-down systems, E-track accessories, and cargo securing equipment designed for trailers, 4WDs, utes, trucks, caravans, and everyday transport applications.

Our mission is simple: help customers secure their loads safely, quickly, and with confidence.

Why Partner With Tiger Australia?

Premium Quality Products

Our products are engineered for durability, reliability, and long-term performance in demanding Australian conditions.

Safety First

Designed to meet the needs of transport professionals, tradespeople, outdoor enthusiasts, and everyday users who value safe cargo restraint.

Convenient & Easy to Use

Our retractable ratchet straps eliminate tangled webbing and make load securing faster and more efficient.

Strong Customer Demand

Cargo securing products are essential for trailer owners, 4WD enthusiasts, tradies, transport operators, and recreational users across Australia.

Affiliate Commission Structure

Earn commissions on every successful referral:

  • 10% Direct Commission on all sales generated through your affiliate link or coupon code.
  • 2% Level 2 (Downline) Commission from affiliates you personally recruit.
  • 1% Level 3 (Downline) Commission from affiliates recruited by your Level 2 affiliates.

Build your network and create additional passive income through our multi-level affiliate program.

Who Can Join?

We welcome:

  • Websites & niche blogs
  • YouTube creators
  • TikTok influencers
  • Facebook content creators
  • Instagram influencers
  • Online communities & forums
  • Email marketers
  • 4WD, camping, caravan and trailer-focused content creators

Marketing Resources

Affiliates receive:

  • Unique affiliate tracking links
  • Exclusive discount coupon codes
  • Promotional banners and creatives
  • Product information and sales support

Why Customers Choose Tiger Australia

  • Premium-grade materials
  • Innovative retractable ratchet strap systems
  • Tangle-free storage solutions
  • Reliable load security
  • Fast and easy operation
  • Trusted Australian brand

Start Earning Today

Join the Tiger Australia Affiliate Program and promote high-quality cargo securing products that customers genuinely need. Earn up to three levels of commissions while helping Australians transport their loads safely and securely.

Tiger Australia Partner Program Terms & Conditions

Welcome to the Tiger Australia Partner Program.

Thank you for joining our affiliate and partner network. By participating in the Program, you agree to the following Terms & Conditions.

1. Affiliate Approval

Tiger Australia reserves the right to approve or reject any affiliate application at our sole discretion.

We may suspend or terminate affiliate accounts that violate these terms or engage in suspicious, abusive, or fraudulent activity.

2. Affiliate Links & Coupons

Affiliates will receive a unique referral link and may also receive a branded coupon code.

• Referral commissions are tracked through affiliate links and/or assigned coupon codes
• If multiple affiliate links are clicked, the most recent valid referral link will receive commission attribution
• Affiliates will not receive duplicate commissions from both referral links and coupon codes on the same order
• Unauthorized distribution of coupon codes on coupon, cashback, or deal websites is prohibited unless approved by Tiger Australia
• Tiger Australia reserves the right to disable or revoke coupon codes at any time

3. Commission Structure

Our Partner Program offers both direct referral commissions and additional team leader bonuses.

• 10% Direct Referral Commission on your own referred sales
• 2% Level 1 Team Bonus from direct affiliate referrals
• 1% Level 2 Team Bonus from indirect affiliate referrals

Commission calculations exclude shipping fees, taxes, refunds, cancelled orders, disputed payments, and fraudulent transactions.

4. Network / Team Leader Rewards

Affiliates may invite others to join the Program using their referral link.

Eligible affiliates may receive additional team leader bonuses when referred affiliates generate qualifying sales, based on the current commission structure.

Tiger Australia reserves the right to review referral network activity and deny commissions related to abuse, fake accounts, self-referrals, or fraudulent behaviour.

5. Self-Referral & Fraud Prevention

Self-referrals are strictly prohibited.

Affiliates may not:

• Purchase products through their own affiliate links or coupon codes
• Create multiple affiliate accounts for personal gain
• Use fake identities, fraudulent orders, or misleading promotions
• Attempt to manipulate the commission system

Orders identified as fraudulent, self-referred, refunded, cancelled, disputed, or abusive will not qualify for commission payouts.

6. Search Advertising & Brand Protection

Affiliates may not bid on Tiger Australia branded keywords, trademarks, or domain names in Google Ads, Bing Ads, or other search advertising platforms without written approval.

This includes terms such as:

• Tiger Australia
• Tiger Australia straps
• Tiger ratchet straps
• Any misspellings or variations of our brand

7. Marketing & Promotion

Affiliates may promote Tiger Australia through approved online and offline channels, including:

• YouTube
• TikTok
• Facebook
• Instagram
• Blogs & websites
• Trade & community groups

Spam, misleading advertising, fake reviews, or unauthorized advertising methods are prohibited.

8. Cookies & Tracking

Affiliate referrals are tracked using cookies.

Cookie duration is stated on the affiliate registration page. If multiple affiliate links are clicked, the latest valid referral link will receive attribution.

If customers block or clear cookies, referral tracking may not function correctly.

9. Payments

Commission payments are made only on successfully completed and approved orders after 30 days from the order date.

Tiger Australia reserves the right to manually review and approve commissions before payout.

Minimum payout thresholds may apply.

Payment schedules and methods are displayed in the Affiliate Dashboard.

10. Removal from Program

Affiliates may leave the Program at any time by contacting:

sales@tigeraustralia.com.au

Tiger Australia reserves the right to suspend or remove affiliates who violate these Terms & Conditions.

Thank you for being part of the Tiger Australia Partner Program.

We look forward to growing together.
